signs.aries: You fall for people fast and hard, your creative work starts in a rush, and you play to win even when nothing is at stake.
signs.taurus: Your pleasures are physical and unhurried, your creative work is made by hand, and your romances are slow to start and slow to end.
signs.gemini: You flirt by talking, keep several creative projects going at once, and are drawn to people who are interesting before they are anything else.
signs.cancer: Romance and family run together for you, your creative work comes from memory and feeling, and you are protective of what you make.
signs.leo: This is where you are most yourself: wholehearted in love, generous with children, and unembarrassed about wanting an audience.
signs.virgo: You are shy about performing and exacting about what you make, and you show affection by attending to the small practical things.
signs.libra: You are in love with being in love, your creative taste is refined, and romance matters to you as an art rather than an appetite.
signs.scorpio: You do not do casual; your romances are consuming, your creative work goes to uncomfortable places, and you play for real stakes.
signs.sagittarius: You are drawn to romances that widen your world, your creativity needs room to wander, and you take risks for the pleasure of it.
signs.capricorn: You were serious young and play came late; your creative work is disciplined, and you approach romance as something to be built.
signs.aquarius: Your romantic life follows its own rules, your creative work is odd and original, and friendship is the ground your affections grow from.
signs.pisces: Romance arrives as enchantment rather than as a decision, your creative work seems to come through you rather than from you, and children unguard you.
